registers.name: r0
registers.purpose: General purpose. Default operand for the I/O traps (dout, din, …).

registers.name: r5
registers.purpose: Frame pointer — base of the current stack frame (cea uses it).

registers.name: r6
registers.purpose: Stack pointer — push/pop move it. Stack grows downward from the top of memory.

registers.name: r7
registers.purpose: Link register — bl/blr save the return address here; ret jumps to it.

flags.name: N
flags.setBy: add sub cmp and not shifts/rotates mul div rem or xor sext

flags.name: Z
flags.setBy: add sub cmp and not shifts/rotates mul div rem or xor sext

flags.name: C
flags.meaning: Carry out of bit 15 (unsigned overflow / borrow); last bit shifted out for shifts and rotates.
flags.setBy: add sub cmp srl sra sll rol ror

instructions.description: Pseudo-op: assembles to mvi (immediate) or mvr (register).
dr = fp + imm5 (compute effective address; assembles as add dr, fp, imm5).

instructions.operands: dr, sr1, sr2 | dr, sr1, imm5
dr, sr1, sr2 | dr, sr1, imm5

instructions.description: Sets flags from sr1 − sr2; result discarded.

instructions.operands: dr, sr1, sr2 | dr, sr1, imm5

instructions.description: dr = dr ÷ sr, signed integer division (two-operand).
dr = dr mod sr, signed remainder (two-operand).
Sign-extend dr, treating its low sr bits as a signed value (bit width taken from sr).
Shift sr right logically by count (default 1); C = last bit shifted out.
Shift sr right arithmetically (sign-preserving) by count (default 1).
Shift sr left by count (default 1); C = last bit shifted out.
Branch if Z = 0 (not zero / not equal).
Same as brnz (branch if not equal).
Branch if positive: N = 0 and Z = 0.
Branch if less than, signed (N ≠ V).
Branch if greater than, signed (N = V and Z = 0).
Branch and link: lr = pc; pc = label (pcoffset11, ±1024 words).
Branch and link via register: lr = pc; pc = baser + offset6.
pc = lr + offset6 (return from subroutine; same as jmp lr).
Print sr as signed decimal. Defaults to r0.
Print sr as unsigned decimal. Defaults to r0.
Print sr as hexadecimal. Defaults to r0.
Print the low byte of sr as an ASCII character. Defaults to r0.
Print the null-terminated string whose address is in sr. Defaults to r0.
Read a signed decimal from stdin into dr. Defaults to r0.
Read a hexadecimal number from stdin into dr. Defaults to r0.
Read one character from stdin into dr. Defaults to r0.
Read a line from stdin and store it null-terminated at the address in sr. Defaults to r0.
Breakpoint trap (accepted by the assembler; not implemented in the interpreter).

directives.name: .string
directives.description: Emit the characters as words, followed by a 0 terminator. Escapes like \n are supported.

directives.name: .start
directives.description: Set the entry point to label (default: address 0).

directives.name: .org
directives.description: Set the location counter. Accepted but not yet implemented — assembly stops with an error.

directives.name: .global
directives.description: Export label for linking (also .globl). Produces an object module.

directives.name: .extern
directives.description: Declare a label defined in another module. Produces an object module.

examples.title: Hello, number
examples.code:
mov r0, 5
  dout r0
  nl
  halt

examples.title: Standard stack frame
examples.code:
mov r0, 7
  push r0          ; argument
  bl square
  pop r1           ; discard argument
  dout r0
  nl
  halt

square:
  push lr
  push fp
  mov fp, sp
  ldr r0, fp, 2    ; first argument
  mul r0, r0
  mov sp, fp
  pop fp
  pop lr
  ret

examples.title: Loop with a counter
examples.code:
mov r1, 1
loop:
  cmp r1, 5
  brgt done
  dout r1
  nl
  add r1, r1, 1
  br loop
done:
  halt

examples.title: Strings and input
examples.code:
lea r0, prompt
  sout r0
  din r0
  add r0, r0, 1
  dout r0
  nl
  halt

prompt: .string "Enter a number: "
